system.summary: Not one system: the unread cipher pieces of the bundle, each in its own unknown key (nos. 20 and 23 probably share one sign inventory).
system.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026). The letters whose keys were recovered are their own entries: no. 25 (siena25), no. 18 (siena18), no. 14 (siena14), no. 4 (borghesi1456); nos. 6 and 24 are George Lasry's siena1431 (key R4755). This entry lists the unread pieces only and claims no shared key for them, except that nos. 20 and 23 look like one system (same sign inventory), untested.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment of these pieces in print or online; the bundle's read-at-the-time pieces (nos. 8, 10, 13/16, 22) are other keys

conditions.human_role: Set the goal (decipher the 29 letters; try the 42 filed keys first). Instructed that DECODE records marked Decrypted are to be trusted as read.

solution.what: Found the whole busta Concistoro 2308 on DECODE (keys R4746-R4789, letters R4790-R4814, R1858), missed by the 23 Sept scan; downloaded 131 images with the project cookie.
Inventoried fasc. 2 by the pencil numbers (Meister's numbering: no. 4 = 1456, no. 11 = 1478, no. 17 = 1528 hold). Nos. 1 (the 1421 letter), 2, 26-28 are not among the 25 pieces photographed.

Viewed and indexed the 43 key records (1433 Petrucci, c. 1440 frate Bernardino, 1454 Milan ambassadors, Casole, 1478 Bichi, c. 1500 Valentino/Pandolfo keys, 1502, 1536, 1540s Tosta, 16th-c. code books).
Transcribed the unnumbered all-cipher slip R4794 (170 tokens, 38 glyphs, numbers 44, 26, 67, 74 as code groups) from an automatic glyph-segmentation sheet.
Homophonic simulated annealing (homsolve.py, it-cinquecento and la order-4 LMs, unigram KL prior) on R4794: no convergence, restarts disagree.

Checked the alphabets of the 16th-c. keys R4760 (1536), R4765, R4767 (Aglo Venturi), R4768 (Mercanto, lowercase-letter cipher with nulls e g f h k 8 6), R4775 (1502), R4778, R4779, R4785 against nos. 17, 20 and R4794: no match seen.

No. 20 (R4808) transcribed by a subagent: 1,231 tokens, 51 sign names, continuous; clear opening 'Sacra Regia Maiestas ... ante terre pedum oscula', closing 'Scriptum Perusii(?) die penultimo mensis Martii'.
No. 20: homsolve.py Italian/Latin, with and without f/o^n as nulls, and with f as word divider; homsolve2.py Latin: no convergence.
No. 11 (Acciaiuoli 1478, 409 tokens, 44 signs, 'PLUS O' merged): homophonic anneal Italian, no convergence.
No. 23 (R4811) fully transcribed by two subagents: 54 lines, 3,703 tokens; clear 'como vi dirrò' inside the cipher (Italian).

No. 17 (1528, 282 tokens): homsolve2 Italian 40 restarts; best runs throw up 'pitiliano', 'questo', 'cardinal', 'pratica' but no coherent text; crib Pitiliano fixed: no convergence (too short for 40+ signs).
Keys with digit+letter alphabets tested against no. 17: R4778 (c. 1500, 6 = c) contradicts no. 17's commonest sign 6 (a vowel); R4760 (1536), R4768 do not fit.
Gabbrielli key volume I index (Ilardi reel 58, index frames): Acciaioli keys only 1504-1514; no key for Donato Acciaiuoli 1478 (no. 11).

No. 20 + no. 23 (4,900 tokens): homsolve2 Italian/Latin/Catalan/Spanish, order 3-4-5, with f-groups (f o^n, f a, f o) merged as units, with superscripted signs as nulls, with o as null: no convergence.
Bigram-capable solver (sylsolve.py: a sign may stand for a letter or one of 40 Italian bigrams), validated on a synthetic cipher, run on nos. 6, 24 and 23: no convergence.
No. 15 (Bandini 1546-47, 229 tokens): key R4764 (Buoninsegni, orator to His Majesty) transcribed (keys/R4764.txt); partial shape mapping + solver: inconclusive (too short to fill the unmapped signs).

Split under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): nos. 25, 18, 14 and 4 moved to their own entries (siena25, siena18, siena14, borghesi1456) with their transcriptions, keys, readings and validation; nos. 6 and 24 left to George Lasry's siena1431. This entry keeps the unread pieces (nos. 7, 9, 11, 15, 17, 19, 20, 21, 23, R4794) as attempted, open, with no shared-key claim; the pieces read at the time (nos. 8, 10, 13/16, 22) and no. 12 are described in NOTES, not counted.

outcome.method_basis: No filed key of fasc. 1 fits any of these pieces; ciphertext-only homophonic, null-aware and bigram solvers fail on nos. 20+23 and on the short pieces.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No sign of these pieces has a value.

homophonic, null-aware and bigram solvers fail; 'f' + o^n / a / o groups behave as units, probably a syllabic or nomenclator element
Florentine cipher; Gabbrielli's key index has no key for Donato Acciaiuoli
'cifra di Balìa' not identified among the filed keys
R4750 ruled out; nine gloss values only

outcome.notes: Attempted, open: the unread pieces of Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2. Split on 14 Oct 2026; the letters with recovered keys are separate entries.
